Container.Name: tududi-planner
Container.Overview: Tag-triggered AI task planning for tududi. Polls tududi for tasks tagged plan-me, hands each one to headless Claude Code (billed against your Claude subscription, not pay-per-token API usage) for full scoping with optional clarifying questions over ntfy, and writes the resulting plan back to the task's note. Runs alongside the tududi-ingest and tududi-worker containers from the same tududi-bridge image family.

Config.Name: Data Dir
Config.Description: Durable queue DB (shared) plus this container's local repo clone cache

Config.Name: Prompts Dir
Config.Description: Prompt templates -- bind-mounted so edits take effect on container restart, no rebuild needed

Config.Name: Claude Code OAuth Token
Config.Description: Long-lived token from running `claude setup-token` on a machine with an active Claude subscription (Pro/Max/Team). Do NOT set ANTHROPIC_API_KEY anywhere on this container -- see the warning above.

Config.Name: GitHub Token
Config.Description: Read-only, fine-grained personal access token used to clone private project repos for planning context. Leave blank if every repo mapped under github.repos in config.yml is public.
